title: aster tarbagatensis
intro: Aster tarbagatensis, commonly known as the Tarbagan daisy, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the Asteraceae family. It is traditionally used in medicine due to its reported health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Aster tarbagatensis are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial and antiviral activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
